body:
Had a sizable breakfast and a soup for lunch. No other supplements or drugs used beforehand.
T (- 0:00) 15:30
45mg Administered orally, drank ginseng ginger lemon tea to help against nausea
T (+ 0:05) 15:35
Slight grumble heard from stomach
T (+ 0:32) 16:02
Light change in headspace, lightheadedness
T (+ 0:54) 16:24
Gradual incline in intensity. A very light headspace and body high. No nausea. Communication is still capable. Pupils show slight dilation.
T (+ 1:09) 16:39
Slight motion in shadows in corners of vision. 'Flickering' light on occasion. Moments of slight nausea occur periodically.
T (+ 2:11) 17:41
Very strong sensitivity to sound and change in stimuli, going out for a walk (drive)
[Erowid Note: 
Driving while intoxicated, tripping, or extremely sleep deprived is dangerous and irresponsible because it endangers other people.
Don't do it!
]
T (+ 3:01) 18:31
Very intense drive. Sky and clouds outside looked dreamy. Strong visual distortions apparent upon return. Very light headspace remains, a nice body high but stimulating as well, jaws a bit clenched. Going out for a bike ride.
T (+ 4:13) 19:43
Visual distortions, breathing visuals, very stimulating. The sky looked amazing, the breathing and moving clouds.
T (+ 4:50) 20:20
Calm feeling, still very psychedelic-like. Peaceful.
T (+ 5:00) 20:30?
Looked in mirror, half of face began to melt, room was shifting, face began aging, changing expressions, I feel great. Not unease but serenity. Walked in a park, lightning in the distance, clouds illuminated by moon, amazing.
T (+ 7:30) 23:00
Colors still fluctuating. Slight trailing. Stimulating effects still prominent.
T (+ 10:10) 1:40
Shadowy-discoloration still noticeable. Headspace still eminent. Becoming mellow yet elusive.
T (+ 10:16) 1:46
Pupils still very dilated, flickering light & discoloration
T (+ 10:30) 2:00
Went to sleep, was not difficult as body high had become relaxing and calming at this point.
Summary/Retrospect
Overall, I would set this experience as one of my favorite among my other psychedelic encounters. My general impression of the trip is very, very positive. I sensed an overall calming and personal vibe from the very light headspace that came about as the first noticeable effect. This feeling is best comparable to the on a cloud feeling of an Empathogen. The only downside was the sudden spurts of nausea which werent that bad but just uncomfortable. After 4 hours in, this subsided completely.
The duration of the trip added emphasis to the meaning of tripping. The day literally seemed like a journey or trip through multiple momentary experiences. These ranged from driving around and seeing the spectacular stacking early-developing thunderstorm clouds in the distance, illuminated by the late afternoon sun, to watching the sun being consumed by them as the clouds moved vividly nearby during sunset. Also meeting a friend who was gone for some time and going to the park late at night was memorable. Although the visuals were not as exaggerated by this time, just venturing into semi-nature seemed like a spiritual meaningful experience.
The thunderclouds had by now become giant towered storms with constant lightning in the distance, although there was no rain where I was. By the end of the experience (nearing 10-11 hours in), I think tiredness reduced the effects as I could tell the trip would probably have continued for another 2-3 hours in the form of light stimulating and light visuals. Sleep wasnt much of a problem at all; I fell into a deep almost meditative sleep and woke in the morning feeling great. I couldnt recommend this more for a full unoccupied day.
